description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of a bandwidth plan
description_zh: 调用DescribeBandwidthPackageAutoRenewAttribute接口查询带宽包自动续费状态
name: DescribeBandwidthPackageAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan
parameters.name: instance_id

AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled.

true
false (default)
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否开启了自动续费。

true：是。

false（默认值）：否

AutoRenewDuration.description_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: month. Valid values: 1 to 12.

This parameter is returned only if the value of AutoRenew is true
AutoRenewDuration.description_zh:
自动续费时长。单位：月。取值范围：1~12。

仅AutoRenew为true时，该项生效

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan

RenewalStatus.description_en:
The auto-renewal status of the bandwidth plan.

AutoRenewal: The bandwidth plan is automatically renewed.
Normal: You must manually renew the bandwidth plan.
NotRenewal: The bandwidth plan is not renewed after it expires. The system sends a non-renewal reminder three days before the expiration date but no longer sends reminders to renew the bandwidth plan. You can change the auto-renewal status of a bandwidth plan from NotRenewal to Normal or AutoRenewal.

RenewalStatus takes precedence over AutoRenew. If you do not specify RenewalStatus, AutoRenew is automatically used
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
带宽包的自动续费状态。

AutoRenewal：自动续费。

Normal：手动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的带宽包可以修改成手动续费（Normal）后，再自行续费或配置为自动续费（AutoRenewal）。

参数RenewalStatus的优先级高于参数AutoRenew。如果不配置参数RenewalStatus，则默认以参数AutoRenew为准
